dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I look forward to working with you.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Seeing as you've just arrived, I'll share with you some of the experiences that I've gathered over the years.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: In this rapidly changing world, I think there'll always be situations where the experience may be of use to you.
